04 / FAIR PLAY RULES THAT BIND US TOO

Six guarantees, written in advance

One wallet, one code

The code is derived, not issued — a wallet cannot hold two codes, and nobody can reassign one. Fresh wallets get fresh codes; that's physics, not policy.

Self-referral is impossible

The whitelist form rejects a referrer code that equals your own — computed before submission, identical on every device.

Referrer locks at entry

The code recorded when you join the whitelist is final. Re-submitting the same wallet updates your email or tier — never your referrer.

Valid means paid

A referral counts only when the referred wallet completes a presale subscription within the $500 cap. Registrations alone earn nothing — for anyone.

Sybil screening at settlement

Batches of freshly-funded wallets routing to one referrer may be voided at TGE. Honest one-to-one invites are never touched.

No cap games, no secret edits

Referrals never change the $500 ceiling or presale price. And because codes are deterministic, the reward ledger can be re-derived by anyone — audit us.

05 / FAQ

Asked about referrals

Where exactly does my code come from?From your address alone: FNV-1a hash → base36 → last six characters, prefixed SL-. The whitelist form computes it in your browser; this page's lookup computes it again. Two devices, one answer — that's the point.
When and how do bonuses pay out?At TGE, in Spark, to the two wallets named in the referral — no claims, no forms. The bonus follows the same unlock schedule as the subscription it rewards. Final percentages are frozen by Aether vote before the presale opens.
I didn't note my code and switched browsers.Nothing is lost — the code was never stored, it was computed. Paste your wallet into the lookup above; the same SL-code comes back on any device, forever.
Can referrals raise my $500 cap?No. The cap is the fairness mechanism of the presale itself — referrals reward participation, they never buy privilege. What grows is your bonus, not your allocation ceiling.
